The '''Whelori system''' was located in the [[Southern Core]] portion of the [[Colonies/Legends|Colonies]].<ref name="TEA" /> It was home to the [[Species/Legends|creatures]] known as [[Whelorian snake-eater]]s.<ref name="JediHonor" /><ref name="Planetnamia" />

==Behind the scenes==
The [[Star system/Legends|star system]] that was home to the Whelorian [[Snake/Legends|snake]]-[[Diet/Legends|eater]] was first introduced as the "Whelor system" in "[[Twinkle, Twinkle Little Star, How I Wonder Where We Are]]," a [[1990]] [[roleplaying game]] source article published in the [[Voyages SF 13|thirteenth issue]] of the ''[[Voyages SF]]'' magazine. The article placed it in the [[Relgim sector/Legends|Relgim sector]] and<ref name="Twinkle">{{VoyagesCite|13|Twinkle, Twinkle Little Star, How I Wonder Where We Are}}</ref> erroneously<ref name="SWS">''[[The Star Wars Sourcebook]]''</ref> claimed that it was referenced in<ref name="Twinkle" /> the [[1987]]<ref name="SWS" /> ''[[The Star Wars Sourcebook]]'', published by [[West End Games]] for use with ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]''.<ref name="Twinkle" /> The article is considered [[Canon|noncanonical]] with respect to the [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] continuity.<ref name="Unlicensed">{{UnlicensedStatus}}</ref> The [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', authored by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], subsequently named the [[Star/Legends|star]] system "Whelori" and placed it in grid square K-13.<ref name="TEA" />

Jason Fry initially intended for the Whelori system to be the location of the [[Serpent Masters]]<ref name="Ophideraan1">{{JCFCite|url=posts/27786181|board=Literature|thread=The Essential Atlas and Galactic Cartography: Official Discussion|user=[[Jason Fry|jasonfry]]|date=2007-11-26|time=7:23 PM|quote=Three examples from the old newspaper strips that are addressed, as drafted: The planet where Luke and Leia run afoul of the Imperial scouts; the planet of the Serpent Masters; and the system where Vrad and the Rebels try to stop the Executor.|archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20220621142905/https://boards.theforce.net/threads/the-essential-atlas-and-galactic-cartography-official-discussion.21938930/page-40#post-27786181}}</ref><ref name="Ophideraan2">{{JCFCite|url=posts/27786787|board=Literature|thread=The Essential Atlas and Galactic Cartography: Official Discussion|user=[[Jason Fry|jasonfry]]|date=2007-11-26|time=9:37 PM|quote=Re Ophideraan, actually I'd missed it. That's one fewer error in the ATLAS -- many thanks. (I'd like to think we would have caught it when we go backwards and forwards over planet lists later, but we might not have.) ... Oh -- for the curious, there goes Whelori's claim to fame.|archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20220621142905/https://boards.theforce.net/threads/the-essential-atlas-and-galactic-cartography-official-discussion.21938930/page-40#post-27786787}}</ref> depicted in the [[The Serpent Masters|eponymous]] [[Star Wars (comic strip)|newspaper comic strip]].<ref name="Serpent Masters">"[[The Serpent Masters]]"</ref> That plan was scrapped, however, when fans on the [[Jedi Council Forums]] at [[TheForce.net]] pointed out that the world in that comic had already been named in the [[StarWars.com]] [[Databank (original)|Databank]] as "[[Ophideraan]]," a fact that to that point had been overlooked.<ref name="Ophideraan1" /><ref name="Ophideraan2" />
